items.heading: Bariis Iskukaris
details: Key ingredients: rice, meat, raisins, xawaash spice
Brown meat with onion and xawaash spice blend.
Add tomato paste and simmer until the meat is tender.
Cook rice in the spiced broth with a few raisins.
Serve the fragrant rice topped with the meat.

items.heading: Sabaayad
details: Key ingredients: flour, water, oil
Knead flour, water and a little oil into a soft dough.
Roll the dough thin and fold it into layers with oil brushed between.
Roll out again into a flat round.
Cook on a hot griddle, flipping until golden and flaky.
